title: Hearty Smoky Vietnamese Hind Shank Cha Gio
description: A smoky and comforting Vietnamese dish featuring hind shank in a steam cooked cha gio, perfect for a cold evening, this version is vegan friendly.

ingredients.name: hind shank
ingredients.notes: substitute with portobello mushrooms for vegan version

instructions: Start by preparing the filling by cutting the hind shank into small pieces and mixing with smoked tofu, vermicelli noodles, carrots, cucumber, mung bean paste, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
Lay a rice paper sheet on a flat surface and add a tablespoon of the filling in the center.
Fold the bottom half of the rice paper over the filling, then fold in the sides and roll up the cha gio to form a tight cylinder.
Repeat the process with the remaining rice paper and filling.
Place the cha gio in a bamboo steamer lined with parchment paper, leaving some space between each cha gio.
Steam the cha gio over boiling water for 15 minutes, or until the rice paper is translucent and the filling is cooked through.
Serve the cha gio hot with a dipping sauce made from soy sauce, sesame oil, and chopped scallions.
Garnish with chopped scallions and a sprinkle of salt.
Let the cha gio rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the flavors to meld together.
